headline: Sectra Reports Increased Sales and Profitability in First-Half Interim Report
summary: Medical imaging IT and cybersecurity firm Sectra reported increased sales and profitability for the first half of the year, driven by strong North American performance.
why: Financial results from healthcare IT providers indicate enterprise software demand across hospitals and medical imaging facilities.
